invariants: Only the three named direct package ranges change; regenerate package-lock.json on current dev and account for every transitive delta against the source PRs.
Freeze an independent seven-name or stronger oracle red before package edits. Preserve existing test identities and coverage floors.

Walk controlled graph, icon and responsive layouts on an isolated production instance at 1440x900 and 390x844. Record screenshot hashes, console errors, missing h1 and horizontal overflow; distinguish a dependency-induced defect from the existing baseline.

Run an isolated npm ci, focused tests, npm audit with remaining advisories reported, the full ten-step unchanged-tree gate, and a committed-tree mutation sweep. Do not weaken any gate to accommodate dependency changes.

Keep each PR open until its exact proposal is represented on dev and all hosted jobs pass. Archive each exact head locally before closure; issue a remote deletion only under an exact-SHA lease if closure leaves that head present.
At most two disjoint writing lanes are active. Only dev is pushed; main, PR #157, unaddressed PRs and dirty worktrees remain intact.
rollback: Restore the three former direct ranges and regenerate the lockfile in a new dev commit. Retain the oracle and archived exact PR heads so every proposal is recoverable.
